slot_note: re-root of seed ET39 after architectures 1 to 3 were spent at stage 4; a statistics office's area residential property price index, read for the housing ministry's rapid price growth designation
niche: a national statistics office's year-to-September 2026 residential property price change for sixteen local authority areas, the change in the market value of each area's census dwelling stock, read against the housing ministry's 8 per cent line, when the dwelling types' prices move apart and each area's sales over- or under-represent apartments against its stock
answer: Ardcullen, Annaghvale, Carrigvore, Dunmarra, Glenaskin, Kilbrannagh and Moyrath designated
analyst_test: With every file conformed and every rule read, a strong analyst who knows a constant-quality index fits one hedonic regression of log price on type, floor area, newness and electoral division with a year term per area and designates Ardcullen, Annaghvale, Dunmarra, Drumshallon, Glenaskin, Innishrue and Kilbrannagh; the easier routes (median change, per square metre, type medians weighted by the census stock, a regression without location) each file another set; only the year effect estimated per dwelling type and combined over the census stock's value of each type designates Ardcullen, Annaghvale, Carrigvore, Dunmarra, Glenaskin, Kilbrannagh and Moyrath.
domain_test: Official house price statistics: an area's index is the change in the value of its dwelling stock, estimated from a changing sample of sales by a hedonic regression and aggregated to the stock with stock value weights, so where the types' prices move apart and the sales mix is not the stock's, a single pooled time effect is the wrong aggregate; with another field's nouns the step survives only where a stock's value is priced from a sample of traded units of unlike kinds.
layer2_pattern: own:a stock's value change taken from a regression on what traded, when the types' prices move apart and the traded mix over-represents one type against the stock
layer1: the price register in two layouts across the October 2025 system change
new-dwelling prices filed exclusive of VAT at 13.5 per cent
addresses joined to the valuation register by property number and to the address point file for the electoral division
sales not at full market price flagged and outside the index
stakeholder_role: head of price statistics at a national statistics office

spine.entity: one dwelling's line on the residential property price register, a block purchase filed as one line per dwelling
spine.source: synthetic (constructed in the layout of a national residential property price register)

driver: A stock's value change is estimated from a regression on the units that traded, but the unit types' prices move at different rates and the traded mix over-represents one type against the stock, so the regression's one period effect is a traded-mix average of the types' changes; the stock's change takes each type's own period effect, holding characteristics and location fixed, weighted by the stock's value of that type.
driver_concrete: Each area's residential property price change is the change in the market value of its census dwelling stock: each dwelling type's year effect from a regression of log price on type, floor area, new-dwelling status and electoral division with a year term per type, combined over the census stock by each type's value, because apartments are a third or more of the sales in Moyrath, Carrigvore, Innishrue and Drumshallon but a seventh of their stock, and their prices moved apart from the houses'.
stump: The default path fits one regression of log price on dwelling type, floor area, new-dwelling status and the address point file's electoral division with a single year term and designates Ardcullen, Annaghvale, Dunmarra, Drumshallon, Glenaskin, Innishrue and Kilbrannagh, because the one year term averages the types' changes over what sold, and in Moyrath and Carrigvore the flat apartments are a third of the sales while in Innishrue and Drumshallon the rising ones are; each type's own year effect weighted by the census stock's value of that type designates Carrigvore and Moyrath in their place.

differentiation.task481: task481 restates counts onto a new classification by conversion rates from a dual-coded window; here no classification changes: prices of a shifting sample of dwellings are held to constant quality by regression.
differentiation.task470: task470 rebuilds activity a sensor never records from units it does; here every sale is recorded and the question is what the traded mix says about the stock's price.
differentiation.task251: task251 reads a unit's error over conditions its check never saw; here no instrument error: a price change for an unchanged dwelling.
differentiation.task479: task479 weighs noisy unit levels against the pool; here no shrinkage: each area's change is the time effect of a regression on the dwellings' characteristics.
differentiation.task464: task464 converts values across instruments by regression and counts units under a cut; here no instrument changes and no unit is converted: the regression holds quality fixed across two periods.
differentiation.task484: task484 counts occupied places when new places fill slowly; here new dwellings sell at a premium and the question is price, not occupancy.

notes: architecture 4: the client's held tasks are compound or keep a dimension in another file; here the size and newness sit in the valuation register and the electoral division in the address point file, and each partial correction files a different wrong set. Architecture 5 (2026-10-22): the decisive step moves from a constant-quality regression (architecture 4, landed by its reader 9) to the aggregation that regression skips: each dwelling type's own year effect weighted by the census stock's value of that type; the pooled regression is now the default path. lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-21 at stage 4: round 1 readers split each parent's return by FTE or total credit hours and missed the call (asks kept 50 per cent on the reissued ids, re-sited); both round 2 readers (target.zip b160b2ca) fitted cost per credit hour by level on the standalone campuses and landed the call (score_reader exit 1); the judge returned DETERMINISTIC APPROVE on round 1. A cost-by-level fit is natural to a strong reader once a credit hour file by level sits beside a consolidated return.
lineage.driver: A combined return reports one total for several units, and each unit's share is split by its head count, which gives every unit the group's average; but the item follows an activity whose unit cost differs several-fold across kinds, and the units inside the return do mostly the cheap kind, which the units that report alone measure, so the split by head count overstates the units inside and keeps them out of the lowest ranks.
lineage.stump: The default path splits each parent's instruction expense among the parent and its branches by FTE students and files 214506, 214682, 214858, 214946 and 215298 awarded, because it never asks whether a branch that teaches mostly lower-division credit hours costs what its system costs per student on average: the campuses that report alone show a lower-division credit hour costing under a third of a graduate hour, and three branches priced at the hours they teach have the lowest instruction expense per FTE in the state.
lineage.niche: a state higher-education coordinating board's 2027-28 instructional investment grant to the five public four-year reporting units with the lowest instruction expense per FTE student in fiscal 2026, from the federal finance and enrollment returns, where six branch campuses' finances are reported inside their parent campuses' returns

lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-21 at stage 4: both readers (target.zip bacb3a67) compared the audit's referred share (35 per cent) with the register's (8 per cent), weighted each stratum to the 30 April register and landed the call, and both resolved the UTC quarter and the restorations (asks 28 of 28)
lineage.driver: A rate over a whole list is read from an audit of a sample drawn at very different rates for the members a screen flagged and the rest, and the flagged members carry the outcome far more often; the audited share overstates the rate wherever flagged members are a small part of the list, and only weighting each audited member by the inverse of its chance of being drawn, a chance recorded only in the screen's own output, recovers the list's rate.
lineage.stump: The default path takes each region's share of its audited records in error and files AR01, AR02, AR04, AR05, AR06, AR07, AR08, AR10, AR11, AR12 and AR13 chosen, because it never asks how the audit drew its records: it took close to a quarter of the records the May risk screen referred and one in twenty-five of the rest, the referred records are in error far more often, and a region's register error rate is its strata's audited rates carried to the records each stratum holds.
lineage.niche: a national statistics office's decision at its November 2026 quality board on which regional business registers go to a 2027 re-validation exercise because their share of records in error exceeds 4 per cent, estimated from the summer 2026 quality audit, whose sample took records flagged by the register's automated risk screen at a far higher rate than unflagged ones

lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-21 at stage 4: both readers (target.zip 29ab3b38) read the board paper's 'those still open on it', censored the open applications at their age, took the product-limit median and landed the call; both kept all 28 ask figures by dating payments on the batch terminal day (score_reader exit 1); the judge returned DETERMINISTIC APPROVE. A duration cohort with an open caseload shipped beside it is read as right-censored by a strong reader.
lineage.driver: A cohort's median duration is read while part of the cohort is still running, and the still-running members are the slow ones; the median of the finished members understates it, and so does counting the unfinished at their age, so only the product-limit estimate that keeps each unfinished member at risk until its age recovers the cohort's median.
lineage.stump: The default path takes each office's median working days over its registered third-quarter applications and files CRO-FM and CRO-MG planned, because it never asks how long the applications still open at the extract will take: they are the slow ones, so the four offices with a backlog look quick on what they have registered, and only the product-limit median over registered and open applications, each open one at risk until its age, gives the quarter's median.
lineage.niche: a business registry's choice of the regional registration offices placed on a timeliness improvement plan because the median working days from a complete application to registration, for applications received in the third quarter of 2026, exceed 20, when at the October extract a share of each office's applications is still open and sits only in the open caseload snapshot

lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-21 at stage 4: reader 9 (target.zip 9e21c3d9) fitted a hedonic regression with the address point file's electoral division and landed the call (score_reader exit 1, asks 14 of 48 from the shared changes); reader 10 fitted it without location and missed (0 of 48); the judge was stopped once the call landed. A hedonic regression is a strong reader's reflex once a methodology note cites the RPPI handbook beside a valuation register, and location is one join away.
lineage.driver: A unit's price change is read from the units of a heterogeneous stock that happened to trade in each period, and the traded mix shifts between periods by location, size and newness, with location held in a separate register; every summary of the traded units, raw, per unit of size or reweighted by a coarse type, moves with the mix, and only a regression of log price on the units' characteristics and fine location with a period term gives the change for an unchanged unit.
lineage.stump: The default path compares each area's sales between the two years dwelling type by dwelling type, weights the changes by the census stock and files Annaghvale, Ballymarne, Carrigvore, Glenaskin, Innishrue, Kilbrannagh, Moyrath and Rathgowan designated, because it never asks whether the homes that sold within each type were the same kind of home in both years: in several areas the second year sold more homes in the cheaper or the dearer electoral divisions, or new homes at a premium, and only a hedonic regression on type, floor area, new-dwelling status and electoral division gives each area's change for an unchanged dwelling.
lineage.niche: a national statistics office's year-to-September 2026 residential property price change for sixteen local authority areas, read against the housing ministry's 8 per cent line for designating rapid price growth areas, when each area's sales in a year are a shifting sample of its dwelling stock and the dwellings' attributes and small-area locations sit in the valuation register and the address point file, not in the price register
